gloss: hiring through personal connections; nepotistic hiring

definitions.gloss: hiring through personal connections; recruitment by referral
definitions.explanation: Employing someone on the strength of a family tie or personal introduction rather than an open selection process. The word is broadly neutral in business usage but often carries a critical edge.

examples.japanese: あの{会社|かいしゃ}は{縁故|えんこ}{採用|さいよう}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: That company does a lot of hiring through personal connections.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{縁故|えんこ}{採用|さいよう}ではなく、{試験|しけん}を{受|う}けて{入|はい}った。
examples.english: He didn't get in through connections; he took the exam.

examples.japanese: {縁故|えんこ}{採用|さいよう}が{続|つづ}くと、{組織|そしき}に{新|あたら}しい{発想|はっそう}が{入|はい}りにくくなる。
examples.english: When hiring through connections continues, it becomes hard for fresh ideas to enter an organization.

notes:
{縁故|えんこ} means a personal or family connection; {採用|さいよう} means hiring. Small firms often use the practice openly, while at large companies and public bodies the word implies unfairness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縁故|えんこ}{採用|さいよう}で{入社|にゅうしゃ}する: to join a company through connections
- {縁故|えんこ}{採用|さいよう}を{廃止|はいし}する: to abolish hiring by connection
- {縁故|えんこ}{採用|さいよう}が{疑|うたが}われる: to be suspected of nepotistic hiring

SIMILAR WORDS:
- リファラル{採用|さいよう}: referral hiring — the modern, positive-sounding loanword for employee referrals
- {公募|こうぼ}: open recruitment — the opposite process, advertised and open to all
